admin_step_up_description: “{action}” is a sensitive action. Verify once and sensitive actions in the next {minutes} minutes won't ask again.
admin_step_up_description_generic: This is a sensitive action. Verify once and sensitive actions in the next {minutes} minutes won't ask again.
admin_step_up_totp_hint: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
admin_step_up_email_will_send: The code will be sent to {email}
admin_step_up_email_will_send_generic: The code will be sent to your verified email
admin_step_up_rescue_note: Rescue mode: your email is on the bootstrap list, so you can use an email code instead of two-factor authentication. This verification is audited and operations are notified.
admin_step_up_error_code_remaining: That code is incorrect. {count} attempts left.
admin_step_up_error_backup: That backup code is invalid or already used.
admin_step_up_error_replayed: That code was just used. Wait for your authenticator to show the next one.
admin_step_up_error_expired: The code expired or ran out of attempts. Send a new one.
admin_step_up_error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
admin_step_up_error_cooldown: A code was just sent. Wait a moment before resending.
admin_step_up_error_email_unavailable: Email is unavailable right now. Use another method or try again later.
admin_step_up_error_method_unavailable: That method isn't available for your account. Use another method.
admin_step_up_error_failed: Verification didn't complete. Try again later.
admin_step_up_locked_body: Try again after {time}. You can still browse the admin console, but not perform sensitive actions.
admin_step_up_none_body: If you lost both your two-factor device and backup codes, ask an operator who can change the deployment environment to turn on rescue mode (ADMIN_STEP_UP_RESCUE) temporarily; your email must be on BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAILS. Then reset two-factor authentication in account settings.
admin_step_up_rescue_banner: Rescue mode is on: admins on BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAILS can verify with an email code. Ask an operator to remove ADMIN_STEP_UP_RESCUE once resolved.
admin_step_up_rescue_banner_short: Rescue mode is on. Remove ADMIN_STEP_UP_RESCUE once resolved.
